durable_continuation.evidence_kind: static inspection of the exact pinned producer and current Lattice consumer, not an executed restore experiment
durable_continuation.producer_behavior: restoreInterruptedTurn synthesizes outcome-unknown tool results and calls retry; retry can remove failed results and execute the same tool batch again with a fresh retry budget
durable_continuation.missing_producer_contract: versioned bounded headless restore with stable model/tool invocation identities, accepted result/artifact references and cursor commit semantics; reconstruct accepted calls without effects or credentials; uncertain-call barrier; compatible runtime/tool state and current host-authority bindings
durable_continuation.consumer_boundary: single-shot --no-session profile and profile-owned argv stay enforced; durable Unknown reconciles retained host evidence without redispatch; no session or transcript is promoted into continuation authority
